title: Let's Dance
djBio: Mor Avrahami came up on the Tel Aviv after-hours circuit and still plays like it — long, patient builds that hold a room past the point most sets would break. Her edits lean on Levantine vocal lines and old disco records, and she cuts almost all of them herself the week she plays them.
partyBio: Forever runs the largest queer nights in Tel Aviv, from the beachfront warehouses to the yearly festival week. It started as a one-off birthday party in 2011 and never stopped; the room is known for booking local residents over touring names and for keeping the floor open until the sun is properly up.
